column1: # canonical_id | recognition anchors | construction and differentiation | failure to prevent

photography/photorealistic|Observed surface roughness, credible reflection and optical focus|Describe how the requested materials respond to one plausible light arrangement; vary sharpness with distance, not uniformly across the image|Plastic skin, impossible reflections, indiscriminate sharpening

photography/portrait|Subject identity, expression and face modeling dominate|Use eye-level framing and a clearly prioritized face when requested; keep identifying features intact and subordinate the surroundings|Inventing a person for a nonhuman request; beauty retouch that erases identity

photography/environmental-portrait|Subject and meaningful surroundings share readable focus|Stage the requested subject within its specified context; allocate enough frame and depth for their relationship to be understood|An isolated headshot with an incidental blurred location

photography/studio-portrait|Controlled key-to-fill relationship against a deliberate backdrop|Specify broad or narrow light, catchlight placement and graduated shadow; separate the subject cleanly without adding narrative props|Unmotivated outdoor scenery or flat featureless face illumination

photography/headshot|Tight head-and-shoulder crop and clear identifying features|Keep eyes and facial planes legible, background restrained and expression faithful; avoid wide-angle near-camera distortion|Full-body fashion staging or clipped facial features

photography/fashion|Garment silhouette, cut, drape and styling lead attention|Describe fabric tension and folds in relation to the requested pose; preserve garment construction and give the silhouette breathing room|Replacing specified clothes or hiding the garment behind decorative scenery

photography/editorial|A composed photograph communicates the requested idea|Make hierarchy and setting support the brief's argument through meaningful placement; keep any inferred metaphor subordinate to literal requirements|Inventing an unrelated social narrative or adding magazine text

photography/lifestyle|Natural activity and believable lived-in arrangement|Favor coherent ambient light, relaxed spacing and context that explains the requested use; retain intentional focal clarity without showroom sterility|Manufactured smiles, unrelated lifestyle props, excessive staged perfection

photography/documentary|Observational framing, available light and contextual detail|Preserve ordinary imperfections and informative surroundings; show only the requested event without inventing factual documentary claims|Glamorized advertising retouch or fabricated evidence

photography/photojournalistic|Readable event, decisive instant and factual spatial context|Freeze the key requested action while retaining enough setting to understand who does what; avoid decorative staging and unsupported historical claims|Generic dramatic spectacle that obscures the event

photography/street|Chance-like urban alignment and decisive framing|Use layers, occlusion and contrasting light to organize the requested street scene; preserve its specified subjects and timing|Invented crowds or random visual clutter mistaken for spontaneity

photography/travel|Geographic character and a coherent sense of place|Use the requested location's supplied features and scale relationships; avoid inventing named landmarks or cultural details|Generic postcard scenery unrelated to the user's location

photography/landscape|Readable landform planes, horizon and atmospheric depth|Establish foreground-to-distance transitions, a purposeful horizon and one consistent light direction; preserve all requested terrain features|Adding mountains or water merely to imitate a reference

photography/nature|Natural growth, ecological texture and ambient illumination|Describe irregular organic spacing and habitat relationships visible in the requested subject; avoid arranging nature like a studio product|Artificial symmetry or unrequested species

photography/wildlife|Species morphology, behavior and habitat remain credible|Use sufficient subject separation and an appropriate observational viewpoint; retain requested animal count, anatomy and action|Cute toy anatomy, invented markings, anthropomorphic props

photography/architectural|Controlled verticals, building proportions and structural rhythm|Align camera and lens treatment with the requested architecture; describe glazing, repeated bays and grounding without bending structural lines|Impossible joints or excessive ultra-wide distortion

photography/interior|Enclosed spatial depth and balanced window/interior exposure|Keep room proportions, material continuity and coherent bounce light; make circulation readable without hiding requested furniture|Clipped windows, floating furniture, invented doorways

photography/real-estate|Broad readable layout, neutral color and consistent scale|Favor informative views with deep focus and straight verticals; retain property proportions rather than stretching the room for drama|Misleading room enlargement or moody darkness concealing layout

photography/product|Accurate silhouette and controlled material reflections|Describe a light shape that reveals the requested object's finish and edges; retain all construction details and supplied branding constraints|Adding a new brand, reshaping the product or confusing gloss with metal

photography/commercial-advertising|Deliberate hierarchy communicates a product benefit|Use a requested benefit as the visual focal relationship; coordinate lighting and placement without inventing performance claims|Decorative spectacle overwhelming the actual product

photography/food|Texture, moisture and edible material response|Choose a view that exposes the supplied food's structure; use directional light to separate surfaces without inventing ingredients or steam|Plastic food, incompatible garnish, impossible heat cues

photography/still-life|Intentional relationships between specified objects and tonal masses|Balance shape, spacing and overlapping planes; keep exact object counts and provide coherent contact shadows|Extra props added solely for composition

photography/macro|Magnification reveals small-scale structure and a narrow focus plane|Name the requested fine structures and the plane that must remain sharp; let surrounding scale cues establish close magnification|Ordinary tight framing without microstructure or invented microscopic anatomy

photography/close-up|Tight familiar-scale detail with recognizable object context|Crop to emphasize the requested feature while retaining enough surrounding shape for identification; avoid unnecessary microscopic cues|Confusing close framing with extreme macro magnification

photography/sports-action|Readable peak action and controlled motion depiction|Keep contact points, equipment ownership and body mechanics coherent; choose frozen subject or deliberate panning according to the request|Duplicate limbs, incompatible blur directions, missing equipment

photography/automotive|Body-line highlights and credible wheel geometry|Shape broad reflections around the requested panels; maintain axle alignment, tire contact and consistent perspective|Bent wheels or highlights that ignore surface curvature

photography/night|Dark ambient setting with localized artificial illumination|Let practical lights motivate pools of exposure and reflections; preserve shadow information needed for the requested scene|Daylight brightness under a dark sky or random neon

photography/low-light|Limited illumination, restrained exposure and shadow texture|Specify the available source and gradual falloff; retain subject readability without pretending the whole scene is brightly lit|Crushed subject detail or arbitrary night scenery

photography/long-exposure|Moving elements accumulate while static structure remains sharp|Separate what moves from what is stationary and describe continuous motion trails; keep light streak direction physically coherent|Global blur or frozen moving material when accumulation is essential

photography/aerial-drone|Elevated viewpoint reveals plan and scale relationships|Describe viewing angle and spatial layout from above; retain geographic connectivity and avoid inventing terrain|Eye-level perspective mislabeled aerial

photography/underwater|Submerged light attenuation, refracted illumination and water depth|Use depth-dependent contrast and credible suspended particles only when useful; keep requested silhouettes visible and water boundaries consistent|Air-like clarity everywhere or implausible bubbles on all surfaces

photography/black-and-white|Luminance hierarchy replaces hue contrast|Translate requested colors into distinct values while preserving their identity in the scene; organize highlights, midtones and deep shadow|Accidental colored accents or uniformly muddy gray

photography/fine-art|Deliberate photographic interpretation and controlled print tone|Use framing, rhythm and tonal restraint to express the supplied idea; preserve literal requirements before any symbolic enrichment|Unrequested symbolic objects or generic prestige adjectives

photography/vintage|Period optical softness and aged photographic reproduction|Choose a coherent period treatment with restrained fading and edge softness; keep required modern objects intact if explicitly requested|Mixing unrelated eras or replacing the requested subject

photography/analog-film|Organic grain, gentle highlight rolloff and restrained halation|Tie grain visibility to exposure and retain underlying detail; avoid treating grain as uniform overlay noise|Heavy digital grit or glowing edges on every object

photography/instant-film|Soft dye response and characteristic instant-print presentation|Favor modest local contrast and plausible print color shifts; add a print border only when consistent with requested framing|Extreme damage that hides the subject or invented handwriting

photography/cinematic|Photographic realism with narrative light and layered depth|Coordinate practical sources, framing and color grade around the requested moment; keep physical surface behavior believable|Arbitrary letterboxing or excessive cinematic color filters

photography/high-key|Predominantly bright tones with delicate edge separation|Retain white-on-white boundaries through soft gradients and controlled shadow; protect texture from clipping|Overexposure that removes subject structure

photography/low-key|Dark tonal field with selective illuminated form|Place a limited key or rim where it reveals essential geometry; retain local separation within shadows|Featureless black subject or excessive bright fill

photography/minimalist|Reduced visual noise and deliberate empty space|Remove only optional background detail; arrange all required subjects with economical shapes and clear separation|Deleting required objects to achieve minimalism

photography/surreal|Photographic material credibility supports an impossible relationship|Keep ordinary optics and lighting consistent while isolating the requested impossibility; do not invent a second narrative|Accidental geometry defects mistaken for intentional surrealism

cinematic-film-still/film-still|An unresolved narrative instant with motivated lighting|Stage the requested action as one readable moment; use foreground and background to support the story without adding events|An advertisement-like isolated object when context is required

cinematic-film-still/feature-film-look|Coordinated production design, blocking and tonal grade|Align set depth, practical light and frame hierarchy around the existing narrative; make materials feel tangible|Unrelated props used as a shortcut for production value

cinematic-film-still/dramatic|Directional visual tension and strong light-dark hierarchy|Use contrast and diagonals to heighten the requested conflict; preserve action readability in the darkest areas|Invented conflict, storms or violence

cinematic-film-still/epic|Large scale, layered depth and atmospheric separation|Show scale through existing scene elements and expansive framing; preserve requested small subjects as identifiable participants|Adding armies or monuments merely to imply grandeur

cinematic-film-still/intimate|Close observation, restrained surroundings and quiet light|Prioritize subtle requested gestures or surface details and a selective focus plane; preserve necessary interaction context|Sexualizing a neutral request or adding an unrelated close-up subject

cinematic-film-still/noir|Hard chiaroscuro, oblique shadows and controlled darkness|Use motivated directional light with graphic shadow masses; retain essential silhouettes and restrained tonal separation|Inventing crime props or making the scene unreadable

cinematic-film-still/sci-fi|Tangible speculative production design with functional light|Ground advanced materials in construction logic and use emissions sparingly; preserve the requested technological premise|Random glowing panels without function

cinematic-film-still/fantasy|Tangible set materials and localized magical illumination|Give the requested magical element a visible source and coherent effect on nearby surfaces; keep ordinary set lighting plausible|Inventing magical creatures or replacing the requested scene

cinematic-film-still/period-film|Historically coherent staging and photographic illumination|Follow the user's specified era; otherwise keep era details optional and avoid invented historical claims|Mixing incompatible periods or changing required modern objects

cinematic-film-still/documentary-film|Observational framing and available-light continuity|Retain informative imperfections and a readable environment; show requested action without polished commercial staging|Fake archival claims or excessive dramatic retouch

cinematic-film-still/commercial-film|Precise hero hierarchy and clean material separation|Control reflection shapes and background contrast to reveal the requested product or service premise|Unrequested logos, copy or performance claims

cinematic-film-still/music-video|Expressive color, visual rhythm and heightened staging|Let repetition, framing and light support the user's mood; keep figures and objects countable through effects|Random performers or strobe-like clutter obscuring the subject

cinematic-film-still/storyboard-frame|Shot-planning lines and simplified value blocks|Prioritize camera placement, staging and direction of action; use arrows or labels only if requested|Polished photographic rendering that hides the planning grammar

cinematic-film-still/anamorphic|Wide horizontal organization and characteristic lens cues|Use stretched highlights or oval defocus sparingly where sources justify them; preserve composition if aspect ratio is fixed|Horizontal flare with no bright source or distortion of subject proportions

cinematic-film-still/shallow-depth|One narrow focal plane separates a narrative subject|Identify what must be sharp, especially faces or contact points; keep essential secondary subjects legible|Blurring an explicitly required participant beyond recognition

cinematic-film-still/wide-establishing-shot|Location geography dominates the frame|Make entry points, scale and depth clear before incidental detail; keep any requested action identifiable within the setting|A close-up that omits the requested location

cinematic-film-still/close-cinematic-portrait|Face-dominant framing, motivated side light and film texture|Keep identity and expression faithful; use background atmosphere only to support the requested moment|Inventing a human when the request specifies another subject

illustration/digital|Controlled digital brush edges and designed color shapes|Alternate crisp focal edges with softer supporting passages; describe brush behavior rather than a generic quality label|Uniform airbrushing that erases style structure

illustration/editorial|A concise visual idea expressed through designed relationships|Use the user's supplied concept as the organizing metaphor; keep literal required content identifiable|Inventing a new message or unrelated symbolic props

illustration/childrens-book|Readable shapes and tactile approachable illustration|Simplify secondary detail and keep requested action easy to follow; choose expressive contours without changing subject count|Unrequested baby proportions or decorative story characters

illustration/storybook|Immersive narrative illustration and selective ornamental detail|Layer the requested environment around the focal action; concentrate texture where it clarifies the story|Detail everywhere with no narrative hierarchy

illustration/educational|Explanatory simplification and consistent visual scale|Expose the requested relationships with clear boundaries and comparable views; use only supplied facts and labels|Invented anatomy, data or explanatory text

illustration/technical|Precise component geometry and functional arrangement|Keep alignment, assembly and part boundaries explicit; distinguish actual visible surfaces from requested sections|Decorative machinery or impossible connections

illustration/scientific|Careful morphology and disciplined comparative observation|Preserve supplied species or structure details and consistent scale; mark uncertainty instead of inventing scientific features|Fabricated specimen anatomy or unsupported labels

illustration/botanical|Plant morphology with fine contour and controlled translucent color|Differentiate leaves, stems and reproductive structures only when requested or clearly implied; retain growth connectivity|Generic flowers substituted for the specified plant

illustration/natural-history|Species description supported by contextual observation|Prioritize diagnostic structure, natural posture and relevant habitat cues; avoid imaginary biological claims|Decorative stylization that changes species identity

illustration/fashion|Garment-led silhouette and expressive fabric drawing|Let line weight and fold rhythm explain the supplied design; preserve construction while selectively elongating presentation|Replacing the outfit or using anatomy distortion that hides fit

illustration/architectural|Building proportions explained with drawn line and wash|Keep structural edges precise while using selective washes for material and depth; avoid unsolicited annotation|Warped verticals or decorative text instead of spatial explanation

illustration/travel|Selective landmark character and handmade place description|Preserve the requested location's supplied features; simplify peripheral detail into coherent shape groups|Invented landmarks or stereotyped cultural accessories

illustration/food|Drawn appetizing texture and expressive edible forms|Use stroke and color variation to explain the requested food's surface; preserve ingredients and serving relationships|Photographic gloss replacing illustrative treatment

illustration/decorative|Flattened embellished forms and rhythmic ornament|Repeat or echo existing requested shapes while preserving focal hierarchy; make embellishment subordinate to content|Added motifs that change the subject or overwhelm required text

illustration/line|Contours and sparse interior marks carry form|Vary contour emphasis for overlap and focus; leave sufficient unmarked ground to keep each shape legible|Tonal fills replacing the defining line structure
illustration/ink|Expressive strokes and decisive dark masses|Group shadows into intentional ink shapes and use sparse highlights for separation|Uniform thin outlines without ink weight or pooling

illustration/pen-and-ink|Fine nib contours and directional hatching|Turn hatch direction with surface planes and build value through density; preserve clean openings around small features|Smooth gray shading that removes visible mark-making

illustration/colored-pencil|Layered colored strokes and visible paper tooth|Build color gradually, preserve stroke direction and reserve lighter paper at highlights|Glossy digital gradients or thick painted impasto

illustration/marker|Broad translucent bands with deliberate contour accents|Let overlapping strokes deepen value and reserve sharp highlights; keep marker edges visible without random streaks|Opaque oil-like blending or uniform vector fills

illustration/flat|Unmodulated filled shapes and clear overlap|Separate planes through hue and shape boundaries; let silhouette and spacing explain depth|Realistic cast-light modeling or volumetric gradients

illustration/minimal|Few necessary forms and generous unmarked space|Retain every required object and attribute while reducing secondary marks; use spacing to establish hierarchy|Omitting semantic requirements in pursuit of simplicity

illustration/geometric|Visible primitive construction and precise intersections|Translate requested contours into deliberate circles, polygons and straight segments while retaining recognition|Organic painterly edges obscuring geometric construction

illustration/textured|Surface grain and varied brush edges remain observable|Coordinate texture scale with subject size and focal detail; leave quiet areas so texture has contrast|A uniform noise layer unrelated to form

illustration/hand-drawn|Irregular contours and selective construction marks|Keep small stroke variations purposeful and structurally consistent; retain legible silhouettes|Malformed geometry justified as sketch looseness

illustration/retro|Period shape economy and limited print-like color|Use a coherent simplified graphic vocabulary with restrained reproduction texture; retain requested content|Arbitrary aging without recognizable period design

illustration/vintage|Historic illustration detail and softened printed reproduction|Combine fine drawn structure with restrained ink fading and paper tone; keep required details readable|Heavy stains that conceal the subject

illustration/whimsical|Playful shape logic and coherent imaginative relationships|Express lightness through proportion and rhythm, using only the user's permitted fantasy content|Unrequested creatures or extra narrative events

illustration/cute|Rounded silhouettes and simplified approachable features|Preserve species and identity cues while softening contours; do not infantilize a specified adult or alter requested anatomy|Generic baby-face replacement or missing distinguishing attributes

illustration/detailed-fantasy|Inventive material detail organized around a magical premise|Concentrate detail on functional joins and focal structures; preserve the requested fantasy rules|Unrelated ornate clutter or fantasy props added automatically

illustration/sci-fi|Crisp designed technology and readable speculative function|Use panel logic, material boundaries and deliberate emissive accents to support the requested design|Random greebles with no structural connection

fine-art-traditional-media/oil|Opaque pigment, bristle marks and selective impasto|Turn strokes with form; reserve thicker paint for focal lights and allow quieter blended passages elsewhere|A uniform embossed filter instead of purposeful brush structure

fine-art-traditional-media/watercolor|Transparent washes, pigment blooms and reserved paper|Build light through untouched support, let wet edges diffuse selectively and retain decisive dry accents|Opaque white paint everywhere or plastic smooth gradients

fine-art-traditional-media/acrylic|Opaque fast-drying layers and crisp overpainted boundaries|Use flat or textured color blocks with deliberate layering; keep edges consistent with dry paint behavior|Watercolor transparency or oily continuous blending by default

fine-art-traditional-media/gouache|Matte opaque color and velvety shaped planes|Build value through overlapping opaque shapes and chalky light accents; keep flat passages visibly painted|Glossy glaze or transparent wash dominating the image

fine-art-traditional-media/tempera|Fine controlled strokes and luminous firm contours|Use thin closely worked layers, disciplined hatch-like modeling and a dry restrained surface|Thick oily impasto or broad wet blooms

fine-art-traditional-media/fresco-inspired|Matte pigment integrated with plaster|Let broad color masses follow the depicted form while fine surface variation belongs to the wall support|Pasted canvas texture or excessive cracks replacing the image

fine-art-traditional-media/pastel|Broken dry pigment and softened transitions|Alternate loose pigment strokes with selective blending; let support grain interrupt edges|Fully smooth airbrush rendering
fine-art-traditional-media/soft-pastel|Powdery color, velvety light and friable edges|Use gentle smudging in broad masses and firmer small accents at the focal area|Waxy ridges or hard plastic shine

fine-art-traditional-media/oil-pastel|Dense waxy strokes and pressure ridges|Build opaque color with visible pressure, dragged edges and selective scratched accents; Blend waxy strokes selectively while retaining pressure ridges and opaque deposited color|Powdery watercolor-like diffusion

fine-art-traditional-media/charcoal|Deep friable blacks, smudged tone and erased lights|Model large value masses first; use lifted highlights and sharp compressed accents sparingly|Uniform graphite-gray lines with no rich charcoal mass

fine-art-traditional-media/graphite|Fine gray values and controlled pencil hatching|Describe form through pressure variation and directional strokes; preserve paper highlights and restrained sheen|Pitch-black ink fills or heavy pastel smudge

fine-art-traditional-media/colored-pencil|Fine layered color marks embedded in paper grain|Build local color through cross-layered strokes and let tooth remain visible at lighter passages|Opaque smooth paint blocks

fine-art-traditional-media/pen|Disciplined nib line and controlled contour detail|Use consistent fine marks, local line density and open paper to establish volume|Broad brush wash replacing pen structure
fine-art-traditional-media/ink-wash|Diluted ink values and soft diffusion|Organize large washes with varied dilution, reserved ground and a few dry anchors|Uniform gray fill or heavy opaque color

fine-art-traditional-media/brush-and-ink|Pressure-sensitive tapering strokes and dry breaks|Let each stroke describe direction and form; balance dense ink against purposeful empty support|Monoline vector contours with no brush pressure

fine-art-traditional-media/chalk|Dusty pale marks and blunt powdery edges|Use broad side strokes with limited sharp accents; let support color influence visible value|Glossy wax sheen or wet painted edges

fine-art-traditional-media/crayon|Waxy irregular coverage and rough stroke overlap|Keep directional scribble visible while maintaining requested geometry and recognizable silhouettes|Polished digital gradients or illegible careless forms

fine-art-traditional-media/mixed-media|Distinct material processes coexist visibly|Assign complementary roles to line, paint and collage without hiding their boundaries; preserve one focal hierarchy|Random textures with no material logic

fine-art-traditional-media/collage|Cut or torn fragments and explicit overlap|Use edge type, scale and layering to assemble the requested scene; preserve count despite repeated fragments|Unrequested printed words or fragmented subject duplication

fine-art-traditional-media/paper-cut|Flat cut silhouettes and clean negative openings|Keep shapes connected plausibly and use overlap rather than painted shading for hierarchy|Thick modeled clay or fuzzy brush edges

fine-art-traditional-media/printmaking|Transferred ink and deliberate impression structure|Choose coherent plate-like mark behavior and limited layered values; maintain clear ink/support separation|Generic digital distress with no print structure

fine-art-traditional-media/woodcut|Gouged channels, heavy dark masses and grain direction|Carve light marks through solid areas, letting cuts follow form with restrained wood character|Fine smooth metal-engraving lines

fine-art-traditional-media/linocut|Bold smooth carved shapes and curved white bands|Simplify tone into cut-versus-ink decisions and keep curved channels intentional|Photographic gradients or excessive wood grain

fine-art-traditional-media/etching|Fine irregular bitten lines and plate tone|Build form with interwoven hatch density and small line irregularities; preserve delicate light areas|Broad stencil blocks or perfectly uniform digital strokes

fine-art-traditional-media/engraving|Precise swelling incised lines and systematic hatching|Wrap disciplined parallel lines around surfaces, tightening spacing to darken values|Soft wash gradients or loose charcoal smudges

fine-art-traditional-media/lithograph|Crayon-like grain and soft printed tonal masses|Retain granular marks within continuous tonal shapes and let contours vary in firmness|Carved white gouges or smooth vector fills

fine-art-traditional-media/screen-print|Flat stencil colors and observable overprint|Use a limited set of coherent ink layers with precise shape separation; allow restrained registration character|Continuous photographic shading or random misalignment

fine-art-traditional-media/pointillist|Discrete color dots create optical mixtures|Vary dot hue and density to explain light while retaining separable marks at useful scale|Blended strokes or uniform confetti unrelated to form

fine-art-traditional-media/impressionistic|Broken brush color and light-led edges|Concentrate on value relationships and selective lost edges; retain the requested scene beneath abbreviated marks|Featureless blur mistaken for painting

fine-art-traditional-media/expressionistic|Emotionally directed distortion and forceful strokes|Exaggerate line and color around the user's mood while preserving count, identity and key action|Arbitrary anatomy errors or unrelated emotional narrative

fine-art-traditional-media/abstract|Painted mass, gesture and material relationships|Translate the requested abstract premise into balanced mark families and focal tension; retain literal objects if explicitly required|Adding arbitrary representational subjects

fine-art-traditional-media/minimalist|A few consequential physical marks on visible support|Use scale, placement and edge quality to carry the composition; omit only optional decoration|Deleting required content or making every mark identical

fine-art-traditional-media/folk-art-inspired|Flattened space, decorative rhythm and handmade symmetry|Use a coherent ornamental grammar without copying specific cultural symbols not requested|Stereotyped motifs or false cultural attribution

fine-art-traditional-media/mural-like|Broad painted forms readable across an architectural surface|Scale focal shapes for distance and subordinate fine detail; keep wall texture consistent with paint|Tiny easel-scale detail dominating the composition

3d-cgi/general-3d|Modeled volume, surface normals and coherent contact shadows|Use an intelligible camera angle, continuous geometry and consistent material response; separate overlapping parts through depth rather than arbitrary outlines|Floating intersections or mismatched shadow directions

3d-cgi/photorealistic-3d|Physically plausible roughness, reflections and indirect light|Describe surface finish and manufacturing detail at a believable scale; maintain consistent reflection environments across adjacent materials|Uniform mirror gloss or impossible refraction

3d-cgi/stylized-3d|Designed proportions and simplified material groups|Simplify secondary geometry while preserving requested identifying features; make silhouette, value and material boundaries carry recognition|Random deformation presented as stylization

3d-cgi/cinematic-3d|Dimensional staging, atmospheric depth and motivated illumination|Use a clear focal light, layered occlusion and selective volumetric effects around the requested scene|Light beams without a source or overprocessed bloom

3d-cgi/character|Readable modeled silhouette and articulated form|Keep requested anatomy, pose and accessories coherent; distinguish joints and contact points without inventing extra features|Fused limbs, disconnected accessories or changed identity

3d-cgi/environment|Consistent spatial scale and layered modeled surroundings|Organize navigable foreground, middle distance and background; align repeated structures and material scale across the setting|Disconnected terrain or perspective inconsistencies

3d-cgi/product-render|Manufactured geometry and deliberate studio reflections|Preserve the requested object dimensions, seams and finish; use broad highlights to reveal curvature and small bevels|Reshaping the product for visual drama

3d-cgi/architectural-visualization|Building geometry, glazing and plausible exterior light|Keep verticals, floor heights and structural joins coherent; show the requested site relationship without invented extensions|Impossible openings or unsupported structural members

3d-cgi/interior-visualization|Enclosure, bounce light and continuous room materials|Show believable furniture scale and circulation; balance illumination from windows and fixtures with contact occlusion|Floating furniture or inconsistent room boundaries

3d-cgi/automotive|Continuous body curvature and designed highlight ribbons|Maintain wheel alignment, tire contact, panel seams and coherent reflections across the requested vehicle|Warped axles or unrelated mechanical additions

3d-cgi/hard-surface|Planar construction, purposeful seams and beveled edges|Make assembly order and part joins readable; use edge highlights to reveal manufactured thickness|Decorative seams that imply impossible assembly

3d-cgi/soft-stylized|Rounded masses, gentle transitions and simplified shading|Keep forms inflated but structurally connected; use soft occlusion and restrained material detail|Melting shapes or loss of required angular features

3d-cgi/clay|Matte sculpted surfaces with pressure and tool evidence|Describe broad modeled planes and selective fingerprints; let soft light reveal irregularities without glossy plastic highlights|Uniform smooth polymer appearance

3d-cgi/claymation-like|Hand-shaped models and tactile set construction|Preserve small handmade variations, practical material seams and intentional posed staging|Photoreal skin or mechanically perfect geometry everywhere

3d-cgi/toy-like|Simplified assembled parts and compact playful proportions|Use clear part boundaries and a coherent manufactured finish while keeping the requested subject recognizable|Turning specified adults into babies or adding unrequested toys

3d-cgi/miniature-diorama|Miniature scale, contained setting and model-like depth|Show a coherent base or bounded terrain only if compatible with the request; use scale-appropriate texture and selective focus|Shrinking required features beyond recognition

3d-cgi/low-poly|Large visible polygon faces and angular silhouettes|Use flat face shading and economical geometry; keep facets large enough to read as deliberate construction|Smooth subdivided surfaces hiding the defining facets

3d-cgi/high-poly|Smooth detailed geometry and controlled fine relief|Preserve clean curvature and purposeful small structure; organize detail density around focal surfaces|Noisy microdetail replacing coherent large forms

3d-cgi/isometric|Equal-axis parallel projection and modeled depth|Keep receding edges parallel and all objects on the same projection; use consistent face values and shadows|Vanishing points or camera perspective convergence

3d-cgi/voxel|Visible uniform cubic units and stepped contours|Build curves and diagonals as coherent block stair-steps with one consistent voxel scale|Smooth curved surfaces or mixed block sizes without purpose

3d-cgi/papercraft|Folded planes, paper thickness and edge shadows|Keep folds and joins physically connected; use visible cut edges to distinguish paper construction from generic faceting|Solid stone-like facets with no paper evidence

3d-cgi/plastic|Molded surfaces, seams and polymer highlight behavior|Choose a consistent gloss or translucency and preserve molded edge thickness; separate reflections from painted color|Metal-like reflections on ordinary opaque plastic

3d-cgi/glass|Transmission, refraction and reflected edge highlights|Show distortion through thickness and a coherent environment visible through transparent regions; retain material boundaries|Invisible silhouette or arbitrary opaque patches

3d-cgi/metallic|Reflections describe surface curvature and roughness|Use reflected light shapes to explain planes, with finish-dependent sharpness; preserve a coherent reflection environment|Diffuse chalky shading or random bright streaks

3d-cgi/ceramic|Opaque fired body with glaze variation|Let glaze collect subtly near recesses and preserve rounded fired edges; distinguish glaze shine from metallic reflection|Transparent glass behavior throughout an opaque vessel

3d-cgi/fabric-felt|Fibrous surface, sewn boundaries and padded volume|Align fiber scale with object size and let seams follow plausible panels; use soft grazing light for texture|Hair-like fur replacing short felt or hard plastic folds

3d-cgi/inflatable|Pressure-expanded volume and welded seam tension|Describe stretched highlights, bulging panels and supported contact; keep pressure consistent across connected chambers|Heavy carved solidity or impossible seam intersections

3d-cgi/holographic|Light-built geometry and luminous spectral separation|Make emissions and transparent interference layers define form; keep background light visible through projected regions|Opaque pearlescent material substituted for projected light

3d-cgi/neon|Emissive geometry illuminates nearby physical surfaces|Give luminous elements a visible body and plausible local spill; preserve readable boundaries beneath bloom|An arbitrary saturated color without emission behavior

3d-cgi/abstract-3d|Nonliteral modeled forms and material relationships|Organize mass, void and surface contrast around the requested abstract premise; keep geometry intentional|Accidental malformed objects or unrelated representational additions

3d-cgi/motion-design-still|Graphic dimensional forms imply organized motion|Use directional spacing, rotation and staged overlap to suggest one coherent motion system|Random floating duplicates or unreadable motion blur

3d-cgi/game-asset|Readable silhouette and purposeful surface simplification|Emphasize form at likely viewing distance and clear functional parts; keep supporting texture subordinate|Detail that vanishes at asset scale or invented equipment

3d-cgi/game-environment|Playable spatial hierarchy and repeated design modules|Clarify routes, barriers, levels and focal destinations using the requested layout|Decorative clutter blocking the implied navigable space

graphic-design/general|Hierarchy, alignment and intentional grouping|Organize requested elements by importance using spacing, scale and contrast; keep all supplied content and avoid invented copy|Arbitrary decoration without communication hierarchy

graphic-design/poster|A dominant visual readable from a distance|Use strong focal scale and clear supporting zones; reserve room only for requested text and preserve its exact wording|Tiny detail competing with the main message

graphic-design/advertising-poster|Product-benefit hierarchy and persuasive visual focus|Prioritize the user's actual offer or subject; use composition to express supplied benefits without fabricated claims|Invented slogans, endorsements or unrelated products

graphic-design/event-poster|Event-specific rhythm and clear information order|Make requested event imagery dominant and group supplied details into a readable sequence|Adding dates, venues or performers not supplied

graphic-design/movie-poster-like|Narrative key art and layered dramatic hierarchy|Use supplied characters or objects to communicate the requested premise; preserve counts through collage-like layering|Invented cast members, credits or title text

graphic-design/book-cover|Compact symbolic hierarchy within a cover format|Choose a focal relationship tied to the supplied story and keep title areas clear only when needed|Unrequested lettering or a new narrative metaphor

graphic-design/album-cover|Unified mood and a memorable bounded composition|Organize supplied imagery into one strong visual identity; follow requested aspect ratio rather than forcing a square|Invented artist names or unrelated musical symbols

graphic-design/magazine-cover|Central feature image with peripheral editorial zones|Keep the main subject unobscured and align supplied cover lines consistently; leave unused zones clean|Pseudo-headlines or text covering identifying features
